ratios.quote: As of December 31, 2025, our Consolidated Leverage Ratio was approximately 4.13 to 1.00 versus our maximum covenant of 4.50 to 1.00.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement; senior secured credit facilities)
ratios.quote: Our Interest Coverage Ratio was approximately 5.51 to 1.00 versus the minimum covenant of 3.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The July 29, 2025 amendment raised the maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio to 4.50x for Q3/Q4 2025, 4.75x for Q1/Q2 2026 and 4.25x for Q3/Q4 2026. After that it returns to 4.50x for Q1/Q2 and 4.00x for Q3/Q4. Before the amendment the 4.00x limit would have applied at year-end 2025, which would have put the actual 4.13x above it. The leverage-based pricing grid and the restricted-payment leverage tests (3.25x, and 0.25x inside the covenant) are excluded because they are not financial maintenance covenants. Pricing is fixed at Tier 1 (>4.25x) through 2026. The company reports compliance as of December 31, 2025.
